name: Mr. Hoffmann
source:
The principal of St. Agnes, is a quite strict old man, nevertheless competent in his work. Many rumors about him are circulating among the professors, abuse of power but also darker things.
He always got by thanks to privileged relationships with people of power.
He seems to have taken a special liking to Juliet ...
